title: Allow usage of biometric protection with PIN instead of master password
symptom: User wants to use a short PIN instead of a regular password for protecting settings/boluses, but currently only a full keyboard password prompt is available, which is hard to type. They also want to combine biometric protection with PIN fallback instead of master password.
evidence_quote: I would really want to be able to use a short PIN instead of a regular password as a protection for my settings/boluses but right now this is not really possible.
